_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Memos
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Memos is a lightweight, self-hosted place for quick notes in Markdown. The first account made becomes the admin, and sign-ups stay closed unless you open them.
startup: if [ "{{OPEN_SIGNUPS}}" = 1 ]; then closed=false; else closed=true; fi; sed "s/@CLOSED@/$closed/" .memos-config.template > .memos-config/raptor.json || exit 1; exec ./memos --addr 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --data data --config-dir .memos-config ${MEMOS_INSTANCE_URL:+--instance-url "$MEMOS_INSTANCE_URL"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Memos: downloads Memos from its GitHub releases, checked against GitHub's
# SHA-256. The data folder (memos, attachments, the database) is never
# touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Memos has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag usememos/memos "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 26.11.1, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x memos ] && [ "$(cat .memos-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Memos $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Memos $version"
    gh-release download usememos/memos "$tag" "memos_${version}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" "$work/memos.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$work/memos.tar.gz" -C "$work" memos
    install -m 0755 "$work/memos" memos.new
    mv -f memos.new memos
    echo "$tag" > .memos-version
fi
mkdir -p data .memos-config
# Memos' declarative configuration, written at every start from Open
# sign-ups: it owns only that switch, so every other setting stays the
# admin's to change in Memos.
cat > .memos-config.template <<'JSON'
{
  "instanceSettings": [
    { "name": "instance/settings/GENERAL", "generalSetting": { "disallowUserRegistration": @CLOSED@ } }
  ],
  "lifecycle": [
    { "resource": "instance/settings/GENERAL", "ignoreChanges": ["generalSetting.customProfile", "generalSetting.disallowPasswordAuth", "generalSetting.disallowChangeUsername", "generalSetting.disallowChangeNickname", "generalSetting.weekStartDayOffset", "generalSetting.additionalStyle", "generalSetting.additionalScript"] }
  ]
}
JSON
echo "Installed Memos $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Memos version to install, such as 26.11.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Open sign-ups
variables.description: Let anyone who can reach the server make an account. Off, only the admin adds users.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The full public address of Memos, starting with http or https, used in links it makes. Leave it empty to use the server's address.
